message.content: {"criteria":[{"id":"C1","level":"Accomplished","mark":8,"evidence":[{"where":"Introduction","quote":"Coral reefs, specifically the Great Barrier Reef, would immensely benefit from dedicated satellite monitoring."},{"where":"Introduction","quote":"Thus, only one satellite is required."},{"where":"Introduction","quote":"The proposed satellite would likely be used by governmental and science agencies (e.g. CSIRO, BOM)"}],"reasoning":"Mission purpose, rationale, single-spacecraft justification and users (operator/customers) all addressed with literature references. Some user detail is speculative ('likely'), but overall strong."},{"id":"C2","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Orbit","quote":"an altitude of 600km requires a mean inclination of 97.7924°"},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","quote":"An average contact duration of almost ten minutes was achieved"},{"where":"Mission Duration & EOL","quote":"The proposed ZYZZsat is small and without thrusters in a low-earth orbit."}],"reasoning":"All major elements covered with STK screenshots and access table. But launch choice is speculative (Vega E not yet built), RAAN 27.33° is inconsistent with Kourou launch site, no hand calcs for inclination, and EOL text is truncated. Errors reduce persuasiveness."},{"id":"C3","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Conclusion","quote":"A specific launch vehicle – the Vega E – has been selected although it has not been built yet."}],"reasoning":"Conclusion summarises design and notes launch risk, but is largely generic recap without quantitative outcomes or critical assessment."},{"id":"C4","level":"Adequate","mark":5,"evidence":[{"where":"Bibliography","quote":"[5] f. https://www.qrg.northwestern.edu"},{"where":"Bibliography","quote":"[10 d. ] https://www.thespacereview.com"},{"where":"Launch","quote":"a wiki sorted directory – ‘Timeline of spaceflight’ – will be referred to throughout the report [6]."}],"reasoning":"Structure and headings are logical, but references are bare URLs with OCR/typo artefacts, Wikipedia used as a source, figures partly unlabelled, and some writing errors. Not professional level."}],"requirements":[{"id":"R1","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R2","met":"yes","where":"Mission Design"},{"id":"R3","met":"yes","where":"Executive Summary"},{"id":"R4","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R5","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R6","met":"yes","where":"Launch"},{"id":"R7","met":"yes","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R8","met":"partial","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R9","met":"yes","where":"Ground Control & Communications"},{"id":"R10","met":"yes","where":"Mission Duration & EOL"},{"id":"R11","met":"yes","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R12","met":"partial","where":"Ground Control & Communications"},{"id":"R13","met":"yes","where":"Contents"},{"id":"R14","met":"partial","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R15","met":"partial","where":"Bibliography"}],"technical_issues":[{"where":"Orbit","issue":"RAAN of 27.33° is inconsistent with a Kourou (5°N) launch into a 97.79° SSO; RAAN depends on launch time, not launch site latitude."},{"where":"Orbit","issue":"Inclination 97.7924° for 600 km SSO is plausible but no hand calculation shown; only a plotted curve."},{"where":"Launch","issue":"Selecting Vega E (first flight 2024, unbuilt) is speculative; no mass/payload compatibility or cost analysis."},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","issue":"Access table has duplicate row 15 and a mislabelled row 6 date; mean duration stated as ~10 min but table mean is 580.8 s (~9.7 min) — minor."},{"where":"Mission Duration & EOL","issue":"EOL paragraph truncated ('utilising a large surface area to ‘'); no quantitative deorbit time or drag-sail sizing."},{"where":"Orbit","issue":"Claim that a high altitude yields 'low resolution images which is also desirable' is a wording/logic error."}],"overall":"A competent, well-structured mission design covering most requirements with STK evidence, but weakened by speculative launch choice, an inconsistent RAAN, missing hand calculations, truncated EOL discussion, and poor referencing including Wikipedia. Adequate overall."}
